newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's CPI rose 0.5 percent in November.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's CPI rose 0.5 percent in November.

text.p: Morocco's Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.5 percent to 148.1 points in November from 147.4 points in October, the Statistics Directorate said on Wednesday.
The rise was due to an increase of between 0.1 percent and 0.7 percent of all products, including food stuff, transport and communications, the Directorate said.
The country's average consumer price was 2.9 percent in the period of January-November 1996 compared with the same period of 1995, it added.
